name: update-harness
summary: Apply a contiguous Project Cortex changelog chain to a consuming vault with dry-run planning, explicit confirmations, local-override protection, and update receipts.
approval_gates: Dry-run the declared changelog chain before mutation.
Obtain explicit confirmation for delete, migrate, or local override resolution.
Never overwrite a locally modified managed file in v0.x.
done_when: installed version and receipt record the result or a partial failure
verification: verify declared source hashes and target paths
